title: Homework: A Spec for a Settings Parser
objective: Write a spec and acceptance table for a small parser, run a generated parser against the rows, find the defects the rows show, and fix the parser to the spec.
prerequisites: Giving the Spec to the Assistant
expected:
"name=archive" -> name=archive pass
"name=archive;" -> name=archive pass
"name = archive ; enabled = true" -> enabled=true, name=archive pass
"url=a=b" -> url=a=b pass
"name=" -> name= pass
"" -> (none) pass
"name" -> error pass
"=archive" -> error pass
"name=a; name=b" -> error pass
";;name=x;;" -> name=x pass
